description:
Produce a FAFSA action checklist for one student, keyed to their grade, dependency status and income band. Answers the process question a family actually has: what do we do, in what order, by when. Does not compute an award.

Cost: about 87 credits (~$0.087) per call.

dependency.description: Dependency drives whose income is reported. unsure is a valid answer and changes the checklist.

grade.description: How far out the family is. 12 means act now.

income.description: Household income band. Drives whether Pell is in play.

notes.description: Anything else that should shape the output.

schools.description: Schools on the list, if known. Deadlines differ by school.

specials.description: Situations that change the filing rules: divorced or separated parents, a stepparent, a sibling also in college, undocumented status, foster care, housing instability, disability, a mid-year income change.

studentName.description: The student this is about. Used in the output text.

timeline.description: Where they are in the cycle.

name: fafsa
title: FAFSA checklist
